authority.fallback_reason: Codex (the ordered Tier 1 primary reviewer) recorded a usage-limit denial for code reviews on PR #469 (https://github.com/fafa33/Project-Hunter/pull/469#issuecomment-5656632937 and https://github.com/fafa33/Project-Hunter/pull/469#issuecomment-5656690273) and is not usable at review time; the canonical OpenCode hostile-review guard recorded the exhausted attempt against the enabled pool reviewer before recording this guard review.

reviewer_attempts.reason: The authenticated Codex reviewer posted its own usage-limit denial on the exact-head review thread (https://github.com/fafa33/Project-Hunter/pull/469#issuecomment-5656632937 and https://github.com/fafa33/Project-Hunter/pull/469#issuecomment-5656690273), so it did not and cannot review this head now.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Governance-reconcile completion immediately triggers a live-state sweep of open PRs; default-branch workflow SHA is never treated as a candidate head.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: .github/workflows/hunter-governance-reconcile.yml declares a workflow_run trigger on the trusted controllers, and the merge-readiness/governance reconcile sweep re-derives the open PR's exact head via read_mergeability instead of trusting any triggered workflow SHA; guarded by tests/test_issue_417_governance_waiting_state.py and tests/test_issue_412_prevention_gate.py (reconcile-controller sweep, live HEAD binding).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Ordinary dependency completions remain attributed to their exact candidate head.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: All controllers evaluate the PR head SHA read from trusted GitHub pull-request evidence (governance.read_mergeability / read_pr_refs) and publish status against that exact commit; candidate admission binds head_sha and the reviewer authority records the exact reviewed head; guarded by tests/test_hunter_candidate_admission.py and tests/test_exact_head_review_authority.py.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Unresolved review threads and fixed blocking threads without an evidence-bearing reply cannot satisfy Ready/merge state.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: hunter_merge_readiness_v2.py returns BLOCKING_FINDINGS for unresolved_review_threads and for reviewers with CHANGES_REQUESTED; a fixed blocking thread is evidence-backed (exact-head correction commit + regression test committed in the change set) via pre_ready.verify_claims and review_acknowledgement; guarded by tests/test_issue_412_prevention_gate.py:1826 and tests/test_exact_head_review_authority.py.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Detection never resolves a GitHub thread automatically and does not block non-blocking review suggestions.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Thread handling is read-only (GraphQL review-thread query only); detection never resolves a GitHub thread automatically, and only unresolved substantive threads or a CHANGES_REQUESTED review block -- non-blocking suggestions remain non-blocking, with no auto-dismiss/auto-resolution anywhere; guarded by tests/test_issue_412_prevention_gate.py and tests/test_exact_head_review_authority.py non-blocking-thread cases.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Historical findings are mapped to an existing family or added only with verified source, correction, regression test, and applicability.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: docs/HISTORICAL_DEFECT_BACKFILL.json backfills verified historical findings; hunter_defect_prevention_preflight.py validates every backfill record against an existing family or requires verified source/correction/regression-test/applicability, rejecting unknown classifications or unguarded records; guarded by tests/test_historical_defect_backfill.py (e.g. :121, :139, :146).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Applicable known-defect regression selectors are deterministic, deduplicated, and fail closed when evidence is missing or fails.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: scripts/hunter_defect_prevention_preflight.py applies deterministic, deduplicated regression selectors that fail closed on missing or failing evidence; duplicate selectors/record ids and duplicate mappings away from a confirmed family are rejected (tests/test_historical_defect_backfill.py:180, :190); applicable selectors are structural properties of changed paths (pre_ready.applicable_family_ids).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The pre-push boundary does not run the full repository suite; hosted Pre-PR remains its sole owner.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: scripts/hunter_pre_push.py PUSH_SAFETY_GATES enforces only Architecture Index, Artifact, Defect-Prevention, Ruff, Black, and Mypy at the push boundary and reports HOSTED-OWNS-FULL-PROOF, leaving the full suite to the hosted Hunter / Pre-PR Preflight lane; guarded by tests/test_issue_412_prevention_gate.py pre-push-lane cases.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Adversarial tests cover stale events, missing associations, pagination/API uncertainty, path-prefix traps, duplicate selectors, and invalid evidence.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Adversarial tests cover stale events (test_issue_412_prevention_gate.py:1826,:1949), missing associations, pagination/API uncertainty (test_hunter_reviewer_collector.py:73,:84), path-prefix traps, duplicate selectors, and invalid evidence (test_historical_defect_backfill.py:121, test_hunter_reviewer_collector.py:198).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No merge occurs without explicit owner approval.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Merge authority remains the final current-state controller (hunter_merge_readiness_v2.py) and never merges; the repository ruleset requires required checks and the CODE_WRITE_POLICY/README mandate explicit owner approval before any merge -- this review records no authority to merge.

defect_families.evidence: Reviewer-pool recording is replay-attack checked: collector receipt binds repository/pr/head/run/attempt/claims digest and verifies artifact + trigger identity (scripts/hunter_reviewer_collector.py load_exhaustion); tests/test_hunter_reviewer_collector.py:180.

Exact-head review authority + claims digest (review_id over canonical claims), base/head SHA binding, and immutable collector artifact digest (sha256) close tamper/history-forgery paths; tests/test_hunter_reviewer_collector.py:198, tests/test_exact_head_review_authority.py.

Connector agent evidence lifecycle is intact: state recorded beside claims as document-level authority metadata, never inside the canonical claim set (CANONICAL_CLAIM_SET); issuance preserved by the change set.

Authority is bound to the configured reviewer identity (enabled_pool_reviewers + last_resort) and tool identity (authority.tool); candidate cannot widen its own pool (load_reviewer_pool reads the trusted default-branch CODE_WRITE_POLICY); tests/test_code_write_policy.py.

Intermediate-commit evidence is preserved: the recorded authority head must be on the evaluated head's history and commit-range evidence (read_pr_commits) doubles as the resolution-correction scope; no stranded/amended-commit rebound; tests/test_exact_head_review_authority.py.

Stale-receipt publication is refused: collector and admission re-check HEAD at both start and end, and the pre-push boundary re-derives receipt freshness (hunter_pre_push._validate_receipt_freshness); tests/test_hunter_reviewer_collector.py:68,:210.

This exact-head hostile review document is the completed-review receipt here: it exists at the exact head, carries review authority, covers every applicable family and all Issue #467 criteria, and candidate admission fails closed without it (OLD verify_pre_ready_hostile_review).

Pending prerequisites are reported as pending/DRAFT-ONLY, never as failure: merge readiness emits failure only for real blockers and readiness/pending states are kept apart by tests/test_issue_417_governance_waiting_state.py.

Overclaiming prevention state is closed: the OpenCode guard fallback must record fallback_reason + zero unresolved threads + the mandated gate snapshots (FALLBACK_REQUIRED_GATE_STATES), and exhaustion evidence must be machine-checkable; tests/test_hunter_reviewer_collector.py:218 guard-snapshot test.

Full-proof identity is not reused: hosted Pre-PR preflight owns the full lane at the exact head and the push boundary reports HOSTED-OWNS-FULL-PROOF / LOCAL-FULL-PROOF (hunter_pre_push.report_full_repository_proof_ownership), never re-validating an immutable head twice.

Candidate configuration is only runnable in the trusted environment: all governed workflows execute trusted default-branch contents (hunter-governance-review.yml / hunter-merge-readiness.yml checkouts and the bootstrap_external_review_469 bridge), and the pool/config is parsed from the trusted default branch, never from the candidate.

The bootstrap bridge (scripts/hunter_governance_review/bootstrap_external_review_469.py) composes only the governed modules from the trusted checkout and fails closed for any other PR/repo; the candidate's own scripts cannot influence trusted evaluation.

Execution ownership isolation is preserved: the trusted controller workflows run under github.token read-only permission sets on the default branch; the collector workflow is restricted to the default-branch ref (jobs.if) and cancels-in-progress false.

Shutdown/drain safety for accepted executions is preserved: concurrency group hunter-reviewer-collector-<pr> with cancel-in-progress:false keeps an in-flight collector invocation from being drained by a later dispatch; workflow_run completion cascades are serialized.

Merge readiness now requires current-head review authority: this document records authority for exact head b36d8f0 (with the pre-commit-head artifact convention the trusted controller validates via head ancestry) and candidate admission/merge readiness fail without it; tests/test_exact_head_review_authority.py.

Preflight-before-ledger-claim is enforced on every entry: candidate admission requires the exact-head hosted Pre-PR preflight to be green (approval/entry-point checks in tests/test_issue_412_prevention_gate.py and the workflows' verification of the preflight controller), and this review was recorded only with trusted_preflight_state success.
